jobs.description:
We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.

This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.
This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).

You'll work in a 2 shift system.
One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)
The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)
- Vaardigheden:
You are flexible
You are able to do physical work 
You can work well in a team
You have your own transportation to get to work on these hours (bike, car, step,..)

- Talenkennis:
English

Are you physically strong? Not afraid of a bit of hard work? Start immediately as a removal worker in a stable team with fair pay. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a removal worker and packer with experience and the right attitude to carry out removal projects professionally and with care.
 

Your duties
 
 

• Packing furniture, household goods and fragile items using the correct protective materials 

• Loading and unloading removal vans 

• Driving, dismantling and assembling furniture 

• Handling customers’ goods with care 

• Contributing to a smooth and efficient move from start to finish 

• Communicating in a customer-friendly and professional manner on the work floor  

 

Your profile
 
 

• You possess all the necessary skills required of a removalist and packer 

• You work accurately and have an eye for detail 

• You are physically fit and not afraid of hard work 

• You can work both independently and as part of a team 

• A basic knowledge of English or French is required 

• Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage 

• You are motivated, flexible and reliable

As a CE driver, you carry out regional distribution runs and deliver goods safely, accurately and with a strong focus on customer service to a wide range of customers.

You will join a growing transport company specialised in national distribution. Safety, reliability and customer focus are key. You can count on clear agreements, personal guidance and a working environment where drivers are valued.

You leave from Desteldonk every day with a dedicated truck. You carry out distribution runs for various customers and are given the necessary independence and responsibility. The planning team provides clear structure, and you have fixed points of contact you can turn to with any questions.

- You carry out regional or national distribution runs for a variety of customers.
- You leave from Desteldonk every day with a dedicated truck.
- You transport goods safely and professionally.
- You follow the schedule and ensure punctual deliveries.
- You communicate with customers in a friendly and professional manner.
- You take responsibility for your routes and equipment.
- You can count on support from the planning team and HR.
- You receive internal training and guidance from experienced colleagues and coaches.

You work from Monday to Friday. You start each day between 4:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m., depending on your route schedule.
- Vaardigheden:
You are customer-oriented and punctual.
You take responsibility while on the road.
You have a flexible and professional attitude.
You preferably live within a 20-kilometre radius of Desteldonk.
You enjoy working independently and value clear agreements.

Valid CE driving licence, valid medical fitness certificate, Code 95 Certificate of Professional Competence and digital tachograph driver card.

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

 

The cream recipe:

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects 

Like Teddy, Business Analyst Business Intelligence at Cream, translate the BI needs of the business teams in specifications for the IT department, for both small demands or as part of larger projects (contributions or BI project). Your tasks will be

• Act as person of contact between Business Engineering Teams and the Development Team

• Define the business specifications for BI needs

• Participation in (or management of) BI projects, or on the BI tracks of other projects for the engineering activities (requirement definition, impact analysis, process definition), while representing the BI vision (and BI target architecture) that has been defined

• Collaboration with data delivery experts to deliver on projects

• Understand business requirements and build a functional analysis which covers needs of the business according to our BI reference architecture

• Collaborate with the development team

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master degree in Computer Sciences or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 2 years of experience in data and business analysis

• You have good knowledge in BI techniques and tools (BO, SAS, Cognos...)

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer oriented, and you have high communication skills and analytical skills

• You are polyvalent and can adapt easily to quickly changing environment

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English; a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

-

jobs.occupation: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

We are looking for a Senior TypeScript Developer to join a project based in Anderlecht (Brussels).
Nice to have

• Experience with Java is a strong asset

• Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure

• Exposure to AI tools and agents (Copilot, Claude, Codex, etc.)

This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic team and contribute to innovative projects in a fast-paced environment. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

Interested? Get in touch to discuss the opportunity.

• Strong experience with TypeScript and Node.js

• Solid background in backend development and API design

• Professional communication skills in French and English

We are looking for packing employees who can work in three shifts and would like to work in the food industry in Dendermonde.

You will work in the packing department of a company that specializes in packing frozen products. You will work in a refrigerated environment (around 10 degrees Celsius).

• Checking the quality of products

• Packing all kinds of products (e.g. fish, snacks, vegetables, ...) in boxes or bags

• Sticking labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Close communication with the operator

• ...

• You have previous experience in a production environment and can work flexible in three shifts.

• You do not mind performing physical work at pace.

• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language in case of safety instructions.

• As the company is located in an industrial zone, it is not accessible by public transport. You can travel each day independently to Dendermonde.

• You are looking for long-term employment and do not mind performing a 2h packing test after a positive job interview.

jobs.occupation: In-House Legal Counsel - Flemish Brabant - Self-employed
jobs.description:

Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Renowned for its collaborative culture, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to talent development, the company offers an excellent environment for young professionals looking to launch their career in Supply Chain.

To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
• Comfortable working with data and supply chain KPIs
• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders
• Team player with a positive and hands-on attitude

jobs.occupation: International Inside Sales - High-Performance Metal Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. 
Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Italian is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products
